population.kidComparison: About 35.6 million people live in Mozambique—roughly the population of a major world region.

geography.climate: Subtropical to warm temperate climate, ranging from sunny coasts to dry inland areas.
geography.terrain: Mix of coastal plains and inland terrain.

anthem.title: National Anthem of Mozambique
anthem.summary: The official patriotic anthem played at national ceremonies in Mozambique.

exploration.didYouKnow: Mozambique is located in Eastern Africa and its capital city is Maputo.
